metadata.title: HolSmt SMT-LIB Coverage
metadata.scope_note: Baseline coverage matrix for current HolSmt parser, HOL-to-SMT-LIB translator, solver entry points, and Z3 proof replay. This is not a completeness claim.

status_legend.implemented: Implemented in current source for the stated surface.
status_legend.parse_only: Parsed or normalized intentionally, with no replay step for this surface.
status_legend.unsupported_diagnostic: Rejected or unavailable through an explicit diagnostic rather than silently accepted.
status_legend.untested: Implementation may exist, but no current checked coverage is identified here.
status_legend.not_applicable: The column does not apply to this row.

source_classes.SMT-LIB 2.7: Official SMT-LIB 2.x surface tracked against the project target.
source_classes.SMT-LIB 3: SMT-LIB 3 surface; tracked separately from the 2.7 target.
source_classes.Z3 extension: Z3-specific syntax, command-line behavior, or proof format.
source_classes.HolSmt: HOL/HolSmt behavior that is not directly an SMT-LIB standard item.

version_targets.evidence: src/HolSmt/SmtLib_Parser.sml parses a restricted SMT-LIB 2 benchmark subset; src/HolSmt/SmtLib.sml emits SMT-LIB 2.
version_targets.notes: Target is versioned as SMT-LIB 2.7, but current code is older SMT-LIB 2 style and does not validate the full 2.7 command/theory surface.

version_targets.evidence: No SMT-LIB 3 specific parser or translator path identified.
version_targets.notes: Tracked separately so future SMT-LIB 3 support does not get conflated with SMT-LIB 2.7.

version_targets.evidence: .github/workflows/docker-ci-for-pr.yml defines an expk Z3_VERSION matrix for 2.19.1, 4.12.4 and 4.13.0; src/HolSmt/Z3.sml exposes configured_executable, configured_version, Z3version and proof-command diagnostics; src/HolSmt/tools/proof-corpus/supported_versions/summary.json records checked-in proof evidence for each supported version.
version_targets.notes: The version data path is available to coverage reporting through Z3.sml and to failures through Z3_SMT_Prover parse/replay wrappers; the proof-corpus manifest validates raw stdout/stderr/proof artifacts for every supported version.

version_targets.evidence: src/HolSmt/Z3.sml detects Z3 v4, uses proof=true pp.simplify_implies=false and reports configured_version in proof diagnostics; src/HolSmt/tools/proof-corpus/supported_versions/manifest.json records v4 proof-mode artifacts for 4.12.4 and 4.13.0.
version_targets.notes: Current behavior depends on HOL4_Z3_EXECUTABLE; replay failures include the discovered version when available, and the checked-in proof corpus validates the normalized v4 rule histogram.

version_targets.evidence: src/HolSmt/Z3.sml falls back to PROOF_MODE=2 when not v4 and reports configured_version in proof diagnostics; src/HolSmt/tools/proof-corpus/supported_versions/manifest.json records legacy proof-mode artifacts for 2.19.1.
version_targets.notes: Retained legacy path; replay failures include the discovered version when available, and the checked-in proof corpus validates the normalized pre-4 rule histogram.

version_targets.evidence: src/HolSmt/CVC.sml invokes --produce-proofs --dump-proofs --proof-format-mode=alethe; selftest has cvc5 proof gates.
version_targets.notes: Included for honesty because selftests exercise it, but the SMT-LIB plan is focused on Z3_TAC completeness.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdSetInfo; benchmark parser accepts set-info and discards content; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Content is preserved in the typed AST and ignored by the legacy benchmark parser.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdSetLogic; SmtLib_Parser.parse_set_logic and SmtLib_Logics.parsedicts_of_logic; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Only listed logic dictionaries are accepted; duplicate set-logic is rejected.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDeclareSort; SmtLib_Parser.parse_declare_sort; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Only arity 0 sorts are accepted; other arities produce a diagnostic.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDeclareConst; SmtLib_Parser.parse_declare_const; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Introduces a nullary HOL constant mapping.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDeclareFun; SmtLib_Parser.parse_declare_fun; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Function arity is checked during later use.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDefineFun; SmtLib_Parser.parse_define_fun asserts the definition formula; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Recursive definitions are not covered by this path.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdAssert; parse_command pushes parsed assertions into scoped state; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers asserted and named assertions.
commands.notes: Named assertion metadata is preserved for later unsat-core/assumption work.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdCheckSat; parse_command records QueryCheckSat; SolverSpec consumes solver sat/unsat/unknown; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the command form.
commands.notes: Parser records the query, not the solver answer.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdGetProof; parse_command records QueryGetProof; SmtLib.goal_to_SmtLib_with_get_proof emits it; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the command form.
commands.notes: Proof production is solver-specific after the command is emitted.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdExit; finalize_state handles exit; translator emits exit; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the command form.
commands.notes: End-of-stream also finalizes a parsed script.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdSetOption; benchmark parser accepts set-option as an explicit no-op; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Option effects are not applied by the benchmark parser.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdGetInfo; benchmark parser accepts get-info as an explicit no-op; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: No response object is produced by the benchmark parser.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdGetOption; benchmark parser accepts get-option as an explicit no-op; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: No response object is produced by the benchmark parser.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDefineSort; typecheck_script validates parameters and the body sort; benchmark parser consumes balanced define-sort syntax as an explicit no-op; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form and malformed diagnostics.
commands.notes: Sort aliases are validated in the typed AST/typecheck path and intentionally not emitted or replayed as solver/proof commands.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDefineConst; SmtLib_Parser.parse_define_const models it as a nullary definition; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the AST form.
commands.notes: Recursive definitions are not covered by this path.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDefineFunRec and CmdDefineFunsRec; typecheck_script and the legacy benchmark parser reject both with explicit unsupported-command diagnostics; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers recursive definition examples and diagnostics.
commands.notes: Recursive definitions are represented syntactically but not expanded into HOL definitions; unsupported diagnostics stop before solver or replay phases.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdDeclareDatatype and CmdDeclareDatatypes with datatype parameters, constructors, selectors, and derived tester records; simple declare-datatype installs parser/typecheck dictionaries; mutual/parametric datatype paths and datatype replay are covered by explicit diagnostics in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml.
commands.notes: Simple datatype declarations are parse/typecheck embeddings. Mutual datatype declarations are not installed into the HOL dictionary, and Z3 datatype theory replay remains explicitly unsupported.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdPush and CmdPop; parse_command maintains scoped assertion/declaration frames; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers stack scoping.
commands.notes: Parser state observes scoped declarations and assertions; proof replay still consumes the final active assertion set.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdReset and CmdResetAssertions; parse_command resets all state or assertion scopes respectively; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers both.
commands.notes: Reset behavior is represented in parser state only.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdCheckSatAssuming; parse_command/typecheck_script record QueryCheckSat assumptions; z3_tac_driver rejects assumed checks with an explicit checked-Z3_TAC diagnostic; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the command form and malformed assumption diagnostics.
commands.notes: Assumptions are preserved syntactically and typechecked, but raw SMT-LIB check-sat-assuming is outside the checked Z3_TAC command-line replay entry point.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdGetUnsatAssumptions and CmdGetUnsatCore; parse_command/typecheck_script record query variants and emit unsupported extraction warnings; z3_tac_driver rejects raw query commands outside checked Z3_TAC; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers the command forms.
commands.notes: Named assertion metadata is preserved, but unsat-core/assumption extraction is not implemented by the checked Z3_TAC path.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdGetModel, CmdGetValue, CmdGetAssignment, and CmdGetAssertions; parse_command/typecheck_script record query variants and emit unsupported response warnings; z3_tac_driver rejects raw query commands outside checked Z3_TAC; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml and conformance tests cover the command forms and diagnostics.
commands.notes: Model/value/assertion output commands are parsed and typechecked where terms are present, but no response object is produced by checked Z3_TAC reconstruction.

commands.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser produces CmdEcho; legacy benchmark parser accepts echo as a no-op; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers both AST and benchmark-parser behavior.
commands.notes: No output response is produced by the parser.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.Core metadata-backed entries expose official status, declarations, and attributes; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml checks Core metadata through SmtLib_Logics.metadata_of_logic.
theories.notes: Includes Bool, true/false, not, implication, and/or/xor, equality, distinct, ite. Equality is recorded as overloaded/chainable; distinct as overloaded/pairwise.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.Ints metadata and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml parser/signature coverage; selftest int arithmetic/inequality categories.
theories.notes: Includes numerals, unary/binary minus, plus, times, exponentiation, div, mod, abs, indexed divisible, and comparisons.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.Reals and selftest real arithmetic/inequality categories.
theories.notes: Division maps through HolSmt.smt_rdiv; some cvc5 real inverse behavior is noted in selftest.
Includes to_real, to_int, is_int and limited implicit Int/Real conversions in selected logic dictionaries.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.ArraysEx maps Array to functions and select/store to application/update; conformance cases qf_ax_select_store_sat, qf_ax_read_over_write_unsat_proof, qf_ax_extensionality_unsat_proof, qf_auflira_mixed_array_int_real_sat, and qf_aufbv_mixed_array_bv_sat cover select/store, read-over-write, extensionality, QF_AX, and mixed Int/Real/BV arrays.
theories.notes: External SMT-LIB arrays parse, typecheck, and solve through Z3 oracle coverage. Checked z3-tac reconstruction currently fails for native HOL function sort encoding with an exact diagnostic.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.Fixed_Size_BitVectors metadata-backed entries plus conformance cases qf_bv_constants_widths_sat, qf_bv_core_ops_unsat_proof, qf_bv_width1_2_boundaries_unsat_proof, qf_bv_shift_rotate_boundaries_unsat_proof, qf_bv_div_rem_zero_unsat_proof, qf_bv_overflow_predicates_typecheck, and qf_bv_int_conversions_typecheck cover constants, indexed literals, concat/extract, bitwise/arithmetic operators, comparisons, boundary shifts/rotates, division/remainder by zero, overflow predicates, Int conversions, and widths 1/2/8/16/32/64.
theories.notes: Z3 4.11 lacks SMT-LIB 2.7 overflow and Int-conversion names, so those are parser/typecheck evidence. Division/remainder-by-zero checked replay has a recorded diagnostic in the soundness-audit row.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.FloatingPoint records RoundingMode, indexed FloatingPoint sorts, Float16/32/64/128 aliases, rounding modes, special values, arithmetic, predicates, and conversion symbols; conformance case qf_fp_advanced_typecheck covers representative parser/typecheck behavior; Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ADVANCED gates fp/fpa th-lemma replay with a versioned proof-format diagnostic.
theories.notes: Floating-point support is a conservative parse/typecheck embedding with abstract HOL terms. Solver and HOL translation completeness are not claimed for this row. Z3 th-lemma replay is explicitly unsupported until Z3 emits enough checked certificate evidence for IEEE operations, NaN, infinity, and rounding-mode lemmas.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.UnicodeStrings records String and RegLan sorts plus string, code conversion, replacement, membership, and regex operators; conformance cases qf_s_unicode_regex_typecheck and qf_s_string_literals_parser_only cover representative typecheck and literal-token parsing behavior; Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ADVANCED gates string/regexp th-lemma replay with a versioned proof-format diagnostic.
theories.notes: Basic string concatenation, length, ordering, and prefix use existing HOL string/list constructors where available; remaining string and regex operators are abstract parse/typecheck embeddings. SMT-LIB string literals remain parser-only because the legacy tokenizer lacks token-kind metadata. Z3 th-lemma replay is explicitly unsupported until proof certificates expose checkable string/regex evidence.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Parser typed AST parser represents SMT-LIB datatype declarations; conformance cases all_simple_datatype_typecheck, all_recursive_datatype_type_error, all_mutual_datatype_type_error, and all_parametric_datatype_type_error cover constructor/selector/tester embeddings and exact unsupported diagnostics; Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ADVANCED gates datatype/dt th-lemma replay with a versioned proof-format diagnostic.
theories.notes: External SMT-LIB datatype declarations are parse/typecheck embeddings. Recursive, mutual, and parametric datatype declarations remain explicit diagnostics in the legacy benchmark parser. Z3 datatype th-lemma replay is explicitly unsupported until constructor/selector/tester certificate evidence is available.

theories.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.Z3_Extensions records Seq, Set, and Bag sorts and representative Z3 sequence/set/bag operators as extension metadata; conformance case all_z3_seq_set_bag_typecheck parses representative signatures through the ALL dictionary; Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ADVANCED gates seq/sequence th-lemma replay with a versioned proof-format diagnostic.
theories.notes: These entries are explicitly marked as Z3 extensions and are abstract parse/typecheck embeddings, not official SMT-LIB 2.7 surface. Solver and HOL translation completeness are not claimed. Z3 sequence th-lemma replay is explicitly unsupported until proof certificates expose checkable sequence evidence.

logics.item: ALIA, ANIA, AUFLIA, QF_ALIA, QF_ANIA, QF_AUFLIA, QF_AUFNIA
logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics parsedicts/metadata plus conformance cases qf_alia_select_non_array_type_error and qf_ax_read_over_write_unsat_proof provide parser/typecheck, Z3 oracle, and exact checked-replay gap evidence for Int array logic coverage.
logics.notes: Core + Ints + ArraysEx; parser does not enforce linearity or quantifier restrictions. Checked replay for native array/function encoding is currently diagnostic-gated.

logics.item: ALIRA, ANIRA, AUFLIRA, AUFNIRA, QF_ALRA, QF_ANRA, QF_AUFLIRA, QF_AUFNIRA
logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics parsedicts/metadata plus conformance case qf_auflira_mixed_array_int_real_sat covers mixed Int/Real ArraysEx parser/typecheck and Z3 oracle behavior; QF_AX replay diagnostics cover the shared array reconstruction gap.
logics.notes: Core + Reals_Ints + ArraysEx; AUFNIRA is also used as part of the current broad Z3 proof dictionary. Checked replay for native array/function encoding is currently diagnostic-gated.

logics.item: LRA, NRA, QF_LRA, QF_NRA, QF_RDL, QF_UFLRA, QF_UFNRA, UFLRA, UFNRA
logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics parsedicts and real selftest categories.
logics.notes: Parser does not validate linearity or other logic restrictions.

logics.item: BV, UFBV, QF_ABV, QF_AUFBV, QF_BV, QF_UFBV
logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics parsedicts, metadata_of_logic, words selftest category, qf_aufbv_mixed_array_bv_sat, and QF_BV conformance cases for constants, widths, operators, comparisons, shifts/rotates, division/remainder, overflow predicates, and Int conversions.
logics.notes: Includes official SMT-LIB 2.7 bit-vector operators plus Int sort/numerals for BV conversion symbols. Z3 4.11 gaps for overflow/conversion names are kept as parser/typecheck evidence; Z3-only proof aliases remain separated in BV_extension_metadata.

logics.item: LIA, NIA, UFIDL, UFLIA, UFNIA, QF_IDL, QF_LIA, QF_NIA, QF_UFIDL, QF_UFLIA
logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics parsedicts and int/nonlinear arithmetic selftest categories.
logics.notes: Parser is permissive and does not enforce linear/difference-logic fragments.

logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics.QF_AX plus conformance cases qf_ax_select_store_sat, qf_ax_read_over_write_unsat_proof, and qf_ax_extensionality_unsat_proof cover select/store, read-over-write, extensionality, Z3 oracle, proof parsing, and exact z3-tac reconstruction diagnostics.
logics.notes: Array-only logic dictionary exists. Checked z3-tac reconstruction currently fails for HOL function sort encoding and is covered by exact diagnostics.
Uninterpreted symbols are represented through declaration dictionaries.

logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics.parsedicts_of_logic and metadata_of_logic; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml checks these scoped Reals_Ints logic dictionaries.

SmtLib_Logics.Strings_Ints combines Core, Ints, and UnicodeStrings dictionaries; conformance cases qf_s_unicode_regex_typecheck and qf_s_string_literals_parser_only check parser/typecheck and literal parser surfaces; advanced th-lemma raw replay tests cover string and regexp unsupported diagnostics.
logics.notes: String logics are parse/typecheck embeddings. Parser does not enforce logic fragment restrictions, and proof replay gates string or regex theory lemmas with versioned proof-format diagnostics.

logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics.FP_Core combines Core, Ints, Reals, Fixed_Size_BitVectors, and FloatingPoint dictionaries; conformance case qf_fp_advanced_typecheck checks representative indexed floating-point signatures; advanced th-lemma raw replay tests cover floating-point unsupported diagnostics.
logics.notes: Floating-point logics are parse/typecheck embeddings. Parser does not enforce logic fragment restrictions, and proof replay gates floating-point theory lemmas with versioned proof-format diagnostics.

logics.evidence: SmtLib_Logics.ALL provides a broad parser dictionary combining current official theory dictionaries with explicitly marked Z3 extension metadata; conformance cases all_simple_datatype_typecheck and all_z3_seq_set_bag_typecheck use it for datatype and sequence/set/bag parse coverage and advanced th-lemma unsupported diagnostics.
logics.notes: ALL is a permissive coverage dictionary for parsing/typechecking selected surfaces, not a soundness or replay completeness claim. Advanced th-lemma replay is explicitly gated.
Tracked separately from the SMT-LIB 2.7 baseline.

Z3_Proof.LEMMA, Z3_ProofReplay.z3_lemma, raw-proof extraction coverage in src/HolSmt/tools/tests/test_record_z3_proof_corpus.py, and minimal raw replay coverage in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success.

Z3_Proof.MP/MP_EQ, Z3_ProofReplay.z3_mp/z3_mp_eq, alias parsing tests in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml, raw-proof extraction coverage in src/HolSmt/tools/tests/test_record_z3_proof_corpus.py, and minimal raw replay coverage in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success.

Z3_Proof.NNF_NEG/NNF_POS, replay functions, raw-proof extraction coverage in src/HolSmt/tools/tests/test_record_z3_proof_corpus.py, and minimal raw replay coverage in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success.

Z3_Proof.NOT_OR_ELIM, Z3_ProofReplay.z3_not_or_elim, raw-proof extraction coverage in src/HolSmt/tools/tests/test_record_z3_proof_corpus.py, and minimal raw replay coverage in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success.
Z3_Proof.QUANT_INST/QUANT_INTRO, replay functions, selftest quantifiers, and minimal raw replay coverage in src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ARITH, Z3_ProofParser indexed metadata preservation, Z3_ProofReplay dispatch, arithmetic selftest categories, and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_th_lemma_existing_theory_replay_minimal_success.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Collected existing subkind shapes are farkas, assign-bounds, eq-propagate, gomory-cut, and triangle-eq. These route through the existing checked arith_prove path; nonlinear arithmetic subkinds are gated separately with a proof-format diagnostic until Z3 emits checkable evidence.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ARRAY, Z3_ProofParser indexed metadata preservation, Z3_ProofReplay dispatch, and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_th_lemma_existing_theory_replay_minimal_success.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Collected existing subkind shapes are select-store and extensionality. These route through the existing checked update-prover path.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_BASIC, Z3_ProofParser indexed metadata preservation, Z3_ProofReplay diagnostic path, and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_th_lemma_basic_unsupported_diagnostic.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Collected existing subkind shape is eq-propagate. It fails with the exact unsupported-shape diagnostic until checked Boolean/equality simplification replay is implemented.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_BV, Z3_ProofParser indexed metadata preservation, Z3_ProofReplay dispatch, selftest words category, and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_th_lemma_existing_theory_replay_minimal_success.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Collected existing subkind shape is bit-blast. It routes through the existing checked word/BBLAST path; this is not a complete guarantee for every bit-vector lemma shape Z3 can emit.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.TH_LEMMA_ADVANCED, Z3_ProofParser indexed metadata preservation for fp/fpa, seq, string/str, regexp/regex/re, datatype/dt, and nonlinear arithmetic labels, Z3_ProofReplay proof-format diagnostics, and src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_th_lemma_advanced_unsupported_diagnostic.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Advanced theory lemmas fail at replay with Z3 version, theory, subkind, proof indices, conclusion, and an explicit proof-format limitation instead of using an oracle or falling through to an unknown-rule error.

z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_Proof.UNIT_RESOLUTION and Z3_ProofReplay.unit_resolution; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml z3_core_proof_rule_replay_minimal_raw_success includes a minimal raw replay proof.

Z3_ProofParser parses proof-bind as a transparent wrapper; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml verifies the wrapper is erased and src/HolSmt/tools/record_z3_proof_corpus.py records it under proof_rule_support.parse_only.
z3_proof_rules.notes: Z3 v4.12.4 proof annotations have no semantic replay step after parser normalization.

z3_proof_rules.item: unknown or future Z3 proof rules
z3_proof_rules.evidence: Z3_ProofParser.proofterm_of_term raises when a proofterm is not in the registry and not an ID; Z3_ProofReplay rule failures include rule and conclusion diagnostics; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml covers unknown parser diagnostics and replay failure diagnostics; src/HolSmt/tools/record_z3_proof_corpus.py records raw proof-rule contexts and --expected-rules/--fail-on-unseen-rules gates proof-format drift.
z3_proof_rules.notes: The discovery gate reports Z3 version, input file, rule name, count, and local proof context for unseen or replay-unknown rules; parser-only wrappers are reported separately.

selftest_categories.evidence: src/HolSmt/selftest.sml arithmetic operators and arithmetic inequalities blocks.
selftest_categories.notes: Includes num/int/real, linear and selected nonlinear arithmetic.
Covers int/real conversion behavior exercised by HOL goals.

selftest_categories.evidence: src/HolSmt/selftest.sml uninterpreted functions and predicates blocks.

selftest_categories.notes: Some solver-specific unknown cases are documented inline.

selftest_categories.evidence: src/HolSmt/selftest.sml let binders and lambda abstractions blocks.
selftest_categories.notes: Lambda support is HOL/Z3-proof related and not claimed as SMT-LIB 2.7 command support.

soundness_audit.item: Binders, shadowing, quoted identifiers, and local definitions
soundness_audit.evidence: src/HolSmt/SmtLib_Parser.sml parses quoted symbols, let, forall, exists, define-const and define-fun; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml smtlib_soundness_audit_scope_success covers quoted |and|, binder shadowing, let shadowing and local-definition tracking.
soundness_audit.notes: This is parser/typechecker coverage. Replay soundness for a solver proof still depends on the checked proof rules for the translated formula.

soundness_audit.evidence: src/HolSmt/SmtLib_Parser.sml typecheck_sort handles indexed sorts and sort applications; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml smtlib_indexed_parametric_sort_reconstruction_success covers Array, indexed BitVec, Float32 and define-sort parameter checking.
soundness_audit.notes: Legacy define-sort aliases are typechecked and discarded rather than installed as reusable aliases; this remains an explicit frontend limitation.

soundness_audit.item: Integer and real division by zero
soundness_audit.evidence: src/HolSmt/SmtLib.sml maps HOL DIV/MOD through EDIV/EMOD preprocessing theorems and real division through HolSmt.smt_rdiv; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml smtlib_soundness_audit_scope_success covers SMT-LIB div-by-zero syntax; src/HolSmt/selftest.sml covers Euclidean div/mod regressions.
soundness_audit.notes: SMT-LIB leaves division by zero underspecified. HolSmt must either use preprocessing theorems that constrain the HOL encoding before replay or reject unsupported proof shapes; no oracle fallback is permitted.

soundness_audit.item: Bit-vector division, remainder and overflow edge cases
soundness_audit.evidence: Conformance cases qf_bv_div_rem_zero_unsat_proof and qf_bv_overflow_predicates_typecheck cover division/remainder-by-zero semantics, overflow predicate parser/typecheck coverage, and the exact checked-replay diagnostic for word division by zero.
soundness_audit.notes: Z3 oracle accepts unsigned division/remainder-by-zero identities. Checked z3-tac replay currently fails in the HOL word division rewrite path; overflow predicates are parser/typecheck evidence because local Z3 4.11 lacks the SMT-LIB 2.7 names.

soundness_audit.item: Floating-point NaN, infinity and rounding-mode semantics
soundness_audit.evidence: SmtLib_Theories.FloatingPoint records indexed FP sorts and rounding modes; conformance case qf_fp_advanced_typecheck covers NaN, infinities, signed zeros, rounding modes, arithmetic, comparisons, and conversions at parser/typecheck level; Z3_ProofReplay reports unsupported fp/fpa th-lemma diagnostics.
soundness_audit.notes: FloatingPoint remains a parse/typecheck embedding until proof certificates expose checkable IEEE evidence for NaN, infinities and rounding.

soundness_audit.item: HOL strings versus SMT-LIB UnicodeStrings and regex
soundness_audit.evidence: src/HolSmt/SmtLib.sml records HOLTheoryEncoding proof obligations for HOL char-list strings and regex; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml smtlib_extended_hol_encoding_records_success checks selected native HOL string translation records; conformance case qf_s_unicode_regex_typecheck covers supported string and regex signatures; Z3_ProofReplay gates string/regex th-lemma replay.
soundness_audit.notes: Selected HOL string operations are emitted as SMT-LIB UnicodeStrings, but replay completeness requires a proof obligation relating HOL char lists, Unicode strings and regex-language membership.

soundness_audit.item: ArraysEx select/store versus HOL function encoding
soundness_audit.evidence: Conformance cases qf_alia_select_non_array_type_error, qf_ax_read_over_write_unsat_proof, and qf_ax_extensionality_unsat_proof plus src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml smtlib_translation_logic_inference_success and smtlib_roundtrip_known_gap_matrix_success record the current HOL function versus ArraysEx behavior.
soundness_audit.notes: External SMT-LIB arrays parse as HOL application/update, while HOL function application is currently emitted as uninterpreted functions rather than native Array select/store. Checked z3-tac array reconstruction fails with an exact higher-order/function-sort diagnostic.

soundness_audit.evidence: src/HolSmt/HolSmtLib.sml GENERIC_SMT_TAC rejects SAT and UNKNOWN results; src/HolSmt/selftest.sml contains sat_Z3 negative theorem tests; src/HolSmt/Unittest.sml holsmt_solver_result_negative_diagnostics checks SAT and UNKNOWN diagnostics deterministically.
soundness_audit.notes: Z3_TAC may only return a theorem for checked unsat proofs. sat and unknown are negative outcomes, not proof-producing cases.
